Revanth Reddy**, the Chief Minister, has drastically reduced his official convoy from nine vehicles to just three as part of a fuel conservation initiative following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's call due to the West Asia crisis.  The decision resulted in the removal of an ambulance equipped with a doctor and support staff, which previously trailed the convoy for emergency medical response. While the reduction has minimized traffic disruptions, it has also raised concerns among security personnel about increased risks associated with commuters deliberately slowing down or filming the convoy.

recent_articles.title: 'Illegal, unacceptable': Pakistan, 13 other nations condemn Somaliland's announcement of opening embassy in Jerusalem - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan**, along with 13 other nations, condemned the opening of a purported embassy in occupied Jerusalem by **Somaliland**. The foreign ministries of these countries expressed their rejection of the "illegal and unacceptable step" as it violates international law and resolutions. They affirmed that East Jerusalem is part of the occupied Palestinian territory and any attempt to alter its status is null and void.  The statement also reiterated support for Somalia's unity, sovereignty, and territorial integrity.

recent_articles.title: The GCC should insure itself against the next Strait of Hormuz crisis | GCC | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **GCC** states are facing economic challenges due to the US-Israel-Iran war and its impact on oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz. While some states like Oman have been minimally affected, others such as Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar face significant disruptions. The GCC needs to implement collective action to mitigate future threats, including establishing swap arrangements that allow for alternative delivery routes and risk mitigation.  These swaps could involve physical, contractual, or quality exchanges of commodities between member states, potentially requiring coordination among national oil companies, refiners, traders, insurers, banks, and buyers in Asia and Europe. The **UAE**, **Oman**, and **Saudi Arabia** have the potential to play a key role in facilitating these arrangements due to their export capacity, infrastructure, and trading expertise.

recent_articles.title: People trapped under collapsed building in Philippines
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Twenty** people are feared trapped under the rubble of a collapsed nine-storey building in Angeles, **Philippines**, with rescue efforts underway.  **24** people have been rescued from the site so far, including two from a nearby hotel struck by falling debris. The cause of the collapse is still being investigated, but officials believe many of those trapped are construction workers who were unable to escape in time.

recent_articles.title: Nationwide pressed to address ‘emerging governance issues’ as AGM looms | Nationwide | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nationwide**, under pressure from **Navendu Mishra**, a **Stockport Labour MP**, is facing scrutiny over its governance practices.  Mishra has raised concerns about the bundling of voting options and lack of board seats for members, echoing similar issues raised by **Rachel Reeves**, the chancellor. The MP also criticized the use of "quick vote" options at annual general meetings (AGMs), arguing it reduces scrutiny and favors incumbents. **Nationwide** maintains that online-only AGMs have increased participation and defends its quick vote system as user-friendly.

recent_articles.title: India voices concern on US visas but sees alignment with Rubio - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** expressed concern over recent US visa restrictions, particularly those targeting Indian tech workers. **Subrahmanyam Jaishankar**, India's foreign minister, criticized the Trump administration's approach to immigration while acknowledging broad alignment on other issues with **Secretary of State Marco Rubio**.  Rubio emphasized shared values and strategic partnership between the two countries despite recent policy shifts that have strained relations.

recent_articles.title: Israeli attack on Gaza kills three family members, including infant | Israel-Palestine conflict News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israeli** forces carried out an air raid on a home in the Nuseirat refugee camp, killing **Mohammad Abu Mallouh**, his wife **Alaa Zaqlan**, and their child **Osama**.  The attack resulted in the deaths of three family members, including a six-month-old child. Medical workers confirmed the casualties, while **Israel** has yet to issue a statement regarding the incident. The attack occurred despite ongoing ceasefire efforts brokered by the **United States**, with **Hamas** and **Israel** accusing each other of violating the agreement.

recent_articles.title: Bolivian minister's convoy ambushed while overseeing roadblock clearance
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mauricio Zamora**, Bolivia's public works minister, was briefly ambushed while overseeing the clearing of roadblocks by protesters. The incident occurred in Copata on Saturday afternoon when **Zamora's** vehicle was targeted with stones and dynamite.  Protests have intensified this week, with clashes between demonstrators and security forces in La Paz, as trade unions and supporters of former President Evo Morales demand the resignation of President Rodrigo Paz over his austerity measures and alleged US involvement.

recent_articles.title: With oil markets nearing the danger zone, a US-Iran deal can’t come soon enough | Heather Stewart | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Oil markets are approaching a dangerous tipping point as tensions between the US and **Iran** have disrupted global supply chains. The International Energy Agency (IEA) warns that oil stocks are being depleted at record rates, with prices remaining below historical highs but poised for significant increases if the strait of Hormuz remains closed.  Several analysts predict a "forced" adjustment to energy demand as prices rise, potentially leading to economic disruption and shortages. **The US** is facing increased costs for consumers due to rising global energy prices, while the **Institute for International Finance (IIF)** warns that the ripple effects of the disruption are spreading beyond oil markets, impacting other commodities like LNG and fertilizers.

recent_articles.title: Security forces kill 11 terrorists in KP's North Waziristan: ISPR - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Security forces** in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's North Waziristan district have killed **11 terrorists**, identified as members of the banned **Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan** (**Fitna-al-Khawarij**) during a series of intelligence-based operations over the past 48 hours.  Weapons and ammunition were recovered from the slain individuals, who were actively involved in numerous terrorist activities. The **ISPR** stated that sanitisation operations continue to eliminate remaining terrorists, as Pakistan's counter-terrorism campaign continues with full force to eradicate foreign-sponsored terrorism within the country.

recent_articles.title: Clashes in Belgrade as student-led protests demand elections | Police News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Students** and antigovernment protesters clashed with **riot police** in Belgrade on Saturday, demanding early elections and the rule of law. The demonstrations followed an anti-government rally organized by a youth movement that has challenged President **Aleksandar Vucic’s** hardline rule for over a year.  The protests were sparked by a train station tragedy in November 2024, which led to calls for accountability and corruption investigations.  **Vucic**, who was on a state visit to China, criticized the protesters' "violent nature" and vowed that Serbia would continue functioning within the law. The **Council of Europe’s** commissioner for human rights, Michael O’Flaherty, has expressed concern over the deterioration of Serbia's human rights situation and reported instances of police protecting attackers against journalists and protesters.

recent_articles.title: Iran’s leader and security council ‘still need to approve’ peace deal with US | US-Israel war on Iran | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** claimed a peace deal with **Iran** has been largely negotiated, but Iranian officials stated that one or two clauses need clarification before the memorandum of understanding can be sent to Iran's supreme national security council and supreme leader. The proposed deal reportedly offers sanctions relief in exchange for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and negotiating on its nuclear program over the next 60 days starting June 5th in Pakistan.  **Iran’s president Masoud Pezeshkian** expressed jubilant mood, while **US Secretary of State Marco Rubio** stated that the deal aims to address Iran's nuclear ambitions and open the Strait of Hormuz. Republican hawks criticized the proposed agreement as too lenient towards **Iran**, with former **CIA Director Mike Pompeo** calling it a "playbook" for building a WMD program.

recent_articles.title: Civilians must not be attacked ‘anywhere’, Pakistan tells UNSC - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan's** ambassador to the UN, Asim Iftikhar Ahmad, urged an immediate ceasefire and renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war in Ukraine during a UN Security Council emergency meeting.  He emphasized that civilians must not be attacked in armed conflict and called for lasting peace through dialogue and cessation of hostilities. **Unicef** director of operations and advocacy, Edem Wosornu, stated that nearly 16,000 civilians have been killed and over 44,000 injured in Ukraine since the war began in February 2022, while **Ted Chaiban**, deputy executive director of **Unicef**, highlighted that more than 3,400 children have been killed or injured since the escalation of the war in 2022.
